Brazier is half-filled with burning charcoal.
It is one of the traditional heating devices.
In addition to heating, you can boil tea or tobacco pipe.
french: Un récipient partiellement rempli de charbon incandescent. Il sert à chauffer la pièce, à faire chauffer le thé ou à allumer une pipe.
english: A vessel partly filled with glowing charcoal. It provides warmth and can heat tea or light a pipe.

source:
The cushion contains cotton etc. as a cushioning material in a cloth bag and is used for sitting on tatami mats and floor.\n
Elasticity as much as Namba cushion is not required and the main purpose is to prevent body temperature from being deprived to the floor.\n
It was made around the Kamakura period, originally used as a symbol of power of authority and high priest.\n
It is said that middle people of the Edo period spread widely among ordinary people.\n
It is a design which was originally completed, and it is widely used even now.
french: Un coussin de tissu garni de coton pour s'asseoir sur un tatami ou à même le sol. Il isole du froid du plancher. Autrefois réservé aux dignitaires, il s'est progressivement répandu dans les foyers.
english: A cloth cushion stuffed with cotton, used for sitting on tatami or the floor. It insulates the sitter from the cold floor. Once associated with dignitaries, it later became common in ordinary homes.

source: Koto is a thirteen-stringed musical instrumentsimilar to a zither.The stirngs stretch over an oblong board.
french: Une cithare japonaise à treize cordes tendues sur une longue caisse de bois.
english: A Japanese thirteen-stringed zither with strings stretched over a long wooden body.

source: Karuta is an indoor playground equipment that uses cards, mainly playing in the New Year.
french: Un jeu de cartes traditionnel japonais, particulièrement apprécié au Nouvel An.
english: A traditional Japanese card game, especially popular at New Year.

source: Shell Matching is a Japanese game transmitted from the Heian period. It was a play of aristocrats who competed for coloring of seashells, beauty of shape, rarity, or singing songs with the shellfish as a theme and competing for superiority or inferiority.
french: Un loisir traditionnel où l'on associe des coquillages. Il évoque les jeux de cour de l'époque de Heian, où l'on admirait leur forme et leurs couleurs et composait des poèmes.
english: A traditional game of matching shells, recalling courtly pastimes in which their shapes, colours and associated poetry were admired.

source: Sugoroku is a board game that advances the piece in the square according to the eyes that waved the dice and brings it closer.
french: Un jeu de plateau où les pions avancent selon le résultat des dés.
english: A board game in which players move their pieces according to dice rolls.

source: An Cassolette is used to heat a perfume in a solid state and emit fragrance components.The nobility of the Heian period was a routine thing for men and women to be able to wear kimonos into incense burners and smell their bodies and clothes with scents.
french: Un récipient servant à chauffer de l'encens solide pour en libérer le parfum. À la cour de Heian, on parfumait aussi les vêtements à la fumée d'encens.
english: A vessel for heating solid incense to release its scent. At the Heian court, incense was also used to perfume clothing.

source:
Fusuma is made by stretching paper and cloth on both sides of a framework made of wood and the like.\n
It is very light, so you can open and close quickly, but durability is low.\n
Although the sliding door has arrived in China, the sliding door is supposed to originate in Japan.\n
Originally it was originated "during lying" and began to be used as a partition of the bedroom.
french: Une cloison coulissante en papier ou en tissu tendu sur un cadre de bois. Très légère, elle s'ouvre rapidement mais résiste mal aux chocs. Elle sert à séparer les pièces.
english: A sliding partition of paper or cloth stretched over a wooden frame. Light and quick to open, but easily damaged, it divides the rooms of a house.

Shoji paper is made by stretching thin paper in a grid-like framework. You can hide faint in the light.
It is very light, so you can open and close quickly, but durability is low.
It is said that the same form as the modern screed shoji appeared was around the time of the Kiyomori before the Kamakura period.
Because it is a structure that is extremely easy to break, it is a daily routine to open a hole in a shoji in a house with pets and children.
french: Une cloison légère constituée de papier translucide sur un treillis de bois. Elle laisse passer une lumière douce tout en masquant la vue. Son papier fragile se perce facilement.
english: A light wooden lattice covered with translucent paper. It admits soft light while screening the view. Its fragile paper is easily punctured.

Byobu is a folding screen which consists of a wooden frame covered with thick Japanese paper or cloth, usually silk.
It is used as a decorative screen or room devider.
french: Un byōbu est un paravent pliant composé de cadres de bois couverts de papier japonais épais ou de tissu, souvent de soie. Il décore et sépare les espaces.
english: A folding screen of wooden frames covered with thick Japanese paper or cloth, often silk. It decorates a room or divides the space.

source: Futon is a thick bed quilt or mattress stuffed with cottonwool.A set of futon placed on Tatami mats is used as bedding.
french: Un matelas ou une couverture épaisse garnie de coton. Posé sur des tatamis, le futon constitue une literie traditionnelle.
english: A thick quilt or mattress stuffed with cotton. A futon laid on tatami serves as traditional bedding.

english: A cotton-filled futon designed for carrying and use as a portable bedroll.

source:
It is a type of furnace permanently installed indoors.
It is a corner established in traditional Japanese houses to cut off the floor square, open ash, spread firewood and charcoal fire.
It is of the type put in the middle of a large room and has various roles such as heating, cooking, lighting, drying.
french: Un foyer aménagé dans une ouverture carrée du plancher, rempli de cendres, de bois et de charbon. Au centre d'une pièce, il sert à chauffer, cuisiner, éclairer et sécher.
english: A sunken hearth in a square opening in the floor, filled with ash, wood and charcoal. It provides heating, cooking, light and a place to dry things.

source:
It is a type of furnace permanently installed indoors.
It is a corner established in traditional Japanese houses to cut off the floor square, open ash, spread firewood and charcoal fire.
Most of the hearths used in the tea room are sized for one tatami mat, mainly used for boiling water.
french: Un foyer aménagé dans le plancher d'une pièce de thé. Il sert principalement à chauffer l'eau de la cérémonie du thé.
english: A sunken hearth set into the floor of a tea room, primarily used to heat water for tea.

source: A low writing desk for copying sutras by hand. Slow, exacting work that doubles as a place to study.
french: Un bureau bas pour recopier des sutras à la main. Un travail lent et minutieux, dans un espace qui sert aussi à étudier.
english: A low writing desk for copying sutras by hand. Slow, exacting work that doubles as a place to study.

source:
It is a type of painted wall.
The roof tiles(Kawara) roofed on the plastics wall also combine rain removal and decoration.
At that time the tiles were expensive, mainly used for the outer walls of samurai residences.
french: Un mur enduit coiffé de tuiles. Ces tuiles le protègent de la pluie et le décorent ; autrefois coûteuses, elles ornaient notamment les enceintes des résidences de samouraïs.
english: A plastered wall capped with roof tiles for weather protection and decoration. Such walls once surrounded the residences of samurai.

source:
It is one with a bay window attached to the wall with tiles.
The bay window functioned as a surveillance window besides the role of giving aesthetic appearance during normal times.
In addition, it fulfills the role of firearms and stone drops at wartime.
french: Un mur coiffé de tuiles et doté d'une fenêtre en saillie. Celle-ci sert à observer les alentours et peut aider les défenseurs en cas d'attaque.
english: A tiled wall with a projecting window for watching the surroundings and supporting its defenders.

source:
Ishigaki is a wall created by assembling stones and rocks, and is mainly used as a defense such as a castle.
Initially it was just a stack of natural stones, but as the era has progressed, things that increased the defensibility by loading stones machined without gaps became mainstream.
french: Un ishigaki est un mur de pierres assemblées, utilisé notamment dans les fortifications. Les ouvrages les plus élaborés emploient des pierres ajustées avec très peu d'interstices.
english:
Ishigaki is a wall created by assembling stones and rocks, and is mainly used as a defense such as a castle.
Initially it was just a stack of natural stones, but as the era has progressed, things that increased the defensibility by loading stones machined without gaps became mainstream.

source:
The moat was dug around the castle and temple from the ancient times to prevent invasion of enemies and animals.
It has width and depth that can not easily be exceeded and it functions as an important defense facility.
Those water-trenched to the moat are called Mizuhori in particular, and have been incorporated into many castles since the modern era.
french: Un fossé large et profond, creusé autour d'une fortification pour freiner les intrusions. Rempli d'eau, il constitue une défense supplémentaire.
english: A wide, deep ditch around a fortification, filled with water to slow intruders.

source:
The staircase is a structure to move to a place with a height difference.
It is divided into several horizontal stages with a height that can be raised and lowered by human feet.
Rimworld without the notion of step difference has no meaning other than appearance.
french: Une marche décorative évoquant un escalier. RimWorld ne représentant pas les différences de niveau du sol, elle n'a ici qu'un rôle esthétique.
english: A decorative step suggesting a change in floor level. RimWorld does not model such changes, so its role here is purely visual.

source:
The castle gate was one of the few places to enter the castle and it was one of the most important defense lines at wartime.
For that reason, it was easy to make a robust structure that can not be withdrawn, and a lot of ingenious efforts were made for interception.
french: Une entrée fortifiée, solide et conçue pour faciliter la défense d'un château.
english: A strong, fortified castle entrance designed to aid its defenders.

source:
The castle gate was one of the few places to enter the castle and it was one of the most important defense lines at wartime.
Some of the gate is made of heavy iron, and even just opening it required a very large effort.
french: Une lourde porte protégeant l'entrée d'un château. Certaines portes historiques étaient renforcées de fer et difficiles à manœuvrer.
english: A heavy door protecting a castle entrance, sometimes reinforced with iron.

source:
The fence is a workpiece that has the effect of preventing invasion of people and animals and blindfolding.
Yamato-Fence is a fence stretched from the front and back with alternating plates one by one.
I open a gap by passing a crosspiece between the boards.
By doing so, it is a simple fence that blocks the line of sight and also passes the wind.
french: Une clôture dont les planches alternent de part et d'autre des traverses. Elle coupe la vue tout en laissant circuler l'air.
english: A fence with boards alternating on either side of its crosspieces. It blocks the view while allowing air to pass.

source:
The fence is a workpiece that has the effect of preventing invasion of people and animals and blindfolding.
Suki-Fence is a covered fence, so that the interior can be seen through by placing a lattice in the middle.
It is mainly used in shrines and temples.
french: Une clôture couverte comportant un treillis central qui laisse entrevoir l'intérieur. On la rencontre notamment dans les sanctuaires et les temples.
english: A covered fence with a central lattice that allows a partial view inside. Often used at shrines and temples.

source:
The fence is a workpiece that has the effect of preventing invasion of people and animals and blindfolding.
Tsuiji-Fence sets up a framework by setting up a pillar on the foundation of stone wall, pouring and kneading the kneading soil.
It has been used in public places and temples since ancient times, and is still often built now.
french: Une clôture traditionnelle en terre pétrie maintenue par une ossature de bois sur un soubassement de pierre. Elle entoure depuis longtemps temples et édifices publics.
english: A traditional wall of packed earth held by a wooden framework on a stone foundation.

source:
Creating traditional Japanese walls is called Makabe.
Makabe has a structure in which pillars and beams are exposed in the room, and it is said that durability is excellent because moisture easily escapes from the inside of the wall.
french: Un mur japonais traditionnel dont les poteaux et poutres restent apparents. Cette structure permet à l'humidité de s'évacuer et favorise la durabilité du mur.
english: A traditional Japanese wall with exposed posts and beams. Its structure allows moisture to escape, helping the wall last.

source: Green Tea is a mixture of powdered tea leaves into hot water.
french: Une boisson préparée en mélangeant des feuilles de thé en poudre à de l'eau chaude.
english: Green Tea is a mixture of powdered tea leaves into hot water.

source:
"Daifuku" is a rice cake stuffed with sweet filling like red bean paste.Daifuku literally means "great luck".
When eating, the fragrance of fresh strawberry spreads in the mouth, you can enjoy the sweetness of soft rice cake texture and elegant sweetness in exquisite balance.
french: Un mochi garni de pâte de haricots rouges et d'une fraise fraîche. La douceur de la pâte accompagne l'acidité du fruit.
english: A soft mochi filled with sweet red bean paste and a fresh strawberry. The fruit's tartness balances the sweet filling.

source:
"Mitarashi Dango" is a skewer dumpling with sugar and soy sauce.
The amber colored sweet taste is compatible with the rice flour dumplings, and the fragrant aroma caused by grilling with charcoal also enhances appetite.
french: Des boulettes de farine de riz en brochette, nappées d'une sauce sucrée à base de sauce soja. Leur parfum grillé ouvre l'appétit.
english: Skewered rice-flour dumplings coated in a sweet soy-based sauce. Their grilled aroma is appetising.

source:
"Geppei" is an old sweet which is eaten in Mid-Autumn Festival in China.
It has a round shape that is regarded as a full moon, wrapped in a soft dough and baked red bean paste mixed with walnuts, pine nuts etc. in soft cloth.
french: Un gâteau de lune traditionnel, garni de pâte de haricots et de fruits à coque. Sa forme ronde évoque la pleine lune de la fête de la mi-automne.
english: A round mooncake filled with sweet bean paste and nuts, traditionally associated with the Mid-Autumn Festival.

source: "Kashihachi" is wrapped in red bean paste with rice cake of rice flour.
french: Un mochi à la pâte de haricots rouges, enveloppé d'une feuille de chêne.
english: A rice-flour mochi filled with sweet bean paste and wrapped in an oak leaf.

source:
"Kasuteira" is confections adopted from Portugal.
However, the actual situation is a completely different sweet that developed independently in Japan.
Kasuteira is made by burning a flour fabric mixed with plenty of sugar and eggs.
french: Un gâteau moelleux aux œufs, à la farine et au sucre. Inspiré de pâtisseries portugaises, il s'est développé au Japon sous une forme propre.
english: A light cake made from eggs, flour and sugar. Inspired by Portuguese baking, it developed its own distinctive form in Japan.

source: "Kintuba" is a sweet made with red bean paste hardened with agar and baked with water flavored flour.
french: Une pâtisserie à la pâte de haricots rouges prise à l'agar-agar et couverte d'une fine croûte de pâte cuite.
english: Sweet bean paste set with agar and cooked with a thin coating of batter.

source: "Nerikiri" is a confectionary refined and adjusted by adding a connecting ingredient to white bean paste.
french: Une pâtisserie façonnée à partir de pâte de haricots blancs et d'un liant, souvent travaillée en motifs colorés.
english: A decorative sweet shaped from white bean paste mixed with a binder, often coloured and formed into delicate patterns.

source: It is a sweet imitating the color of cherry blossoms and the color of young plants.
french: Des douceurs évoquant les couleurs des fleurs de cerisier et des jeunes pousses.
english: Sweets evoking cherry blossoms and fresh spring shoots.

source: "Youkan" is a Japanese sweet made by pouring azuki bean paste in mold and solidified with agar.
french: Une confiserie japonaise de pâte de haricots azuki, moulée et prise à l'agar-agar.
english: A Japanese sweet made from azuki bean paste, moulded and set with agar.

source: Packed earth, dug out and carried in. Mixed with straw and left to dry it makes the daub of a wattle-and-daub wall.
french: De la terre compacte, creusée et transportée. Mélangée à de la paille puis séchée, elle sert à fabriquer du torchis.
english: Packed earth, dug out and carried in. Mixed with straw and left to dry it makes the daub of a wattle-and-daub wall.

source: Wood burned slowly in a starved fire until only carbon is left. It burns hot, steady and nearly smokeless, which is what makes it fit to burn indoors.
french: Du bois lentement carbonisé dans un feu pauvre en air. Il brûle avec une chaleur régulière et peu de fumée, ce qui le rend utile dans les foyers intérieurs.
english: Wood burned slowly in a starved fire until only carbon is left. It burns hot, steady and nearly smokeless, which is what makes it fit to burn indoors.

source: Paper combed from the long bark fibres of the kozo shrub. It is far tougher than it looks: stretched over a light wooden frame it holds up as a wall.
french: Du papier fabriqué avec les longues fibres d'écorce du kōzo. Résistant malgré sa finesse, il peut couvrir une armature légère pour former une cloison.
english: Paper combed from the long bark fibres of the kozo shrub. It is far tougher than it looks: stretched over a light wooden frame it holds up as a wall.

source: Thread reeled off silkworm cocoons and woven, with nothing else blended in. Light, strong and cool against the skin, and slow enough to make that a bolt of it is worth its weight.
french: Du fil dévidé de cocons de vers à soie puis tissé sans mélange. Sa finesse, sa solidité et sa fabrication lente en font une étoffe précieuse.
english: Thread reeled off silkworm cocoons and woven, with nothing else blended in. Light, strong and cool against the skin, and slow enough to make that a bolt of it is worth its weight.

source: Rush is mainly used as a raw material for tatami mats, but it was used as a medicinal herbs in the past.
french: Une plante utilisée pour fabriquer des tatamis, et autrefois employée dans certains remèdes.
english: Rush is mainly used as a raw material for tatami mats, but it was used as a medicinal herbs in the past.

source:
It is the cocoon made by silkworm larvae.
Weaving the thread by spinning it will become the finest textile.
french: Un cocon de ver à soie. On en dévide le fil pour produire une étoffe fine.
english: A silkworm cocoon. Its thread can be reeled off to produce fine silk fabric.

source:
It is a bundle of bark which took from Kouzo Tree.
Fibers of Kouzo bark are strongly intertwined long.
Paper made from Kouzo is strong and lasts long.
french: Un faisceau d'écorce de mûrier à papier. Ses longues fibres entrelacées permettent de fabriquer un papier solide et durable.
english: A bundle of paper-mulberry bark. Its long, intertwined fibres make strong, lasting paper.

french: Un kimono pour la récolte du thé.
Un kimono de maître de thé.

source: Kimono of Princess.Princess' s dignity encourages surrounding friends.
french: Un kimono de princesse. Sa dignité encourage les alliés à proximité.
english: A princess's kimono. Her dignity encourages nearby allies.

source: Kimono of Rikishi.A Yokozuna with a mighty power overwhelms the enemy.
french: Un kimono de lutteur. La puissance du yokozuna intimide les ennemis.
english: A wrestler's kimono. The yokozuna's imposing presence intimidates enemies.

source:
It is an elongated plant inhabited by wetlands and large ones grow to about 1.6 m.
It is mainly used as a raw material for tatami mats, but it was used as a medicinal herbs in the past.
french: Un jonc allongé des zones humides, pouvant atteindre environ 1,6 mètre. Il sert surtout à fabriquer des tatamis et était autrefois utilisé comme plante médicinale.
english: A tall wetland rush used primarily to make tatami mats, and historically in some herbal remedies.

source:
Tie the dark red beans to the sheath.
Beans are cooked or boiled sweet and then made into bean paste.
french: Une plante donnant des gousses de haricots rouge sombre. Ceux-ci se mangent cuits ou sucrés sous forme de pâte.
english: A plant bearing pods of dark red beans. These can be cooked as food or sweetened into bean paste.

source:
It is said that cultivation began in China since BC, it is used not only for edible but also for appreciation.
The tea extracted from the leaves with water is loved around the world.
french: Un arbuste cultivé depuis longtemps en Chine. Ses feuilles infusées donnent une boisson appréciée dans le monde entier.
english: A shrub long cultivated for its leaves, which can be infused to make tea.

source:
In spring, light yellow green flowers bloom and red fruits in early summer.
It is used as a raw material for paper because it can take high quality fibers from the bark.
french: Un arbre aux fleurs vert pâle au printemps et aux fruits rouges en début d'été. Les fibres de son écorce servent à fabriquer du papier.
english: A paper-mulberry tree whose bark provides strong fibres for papermaking.

source:
Mulberry ties the purple of purplish red purple.
It is used as a tree for silkworms since ancient times, it is a plant indispensable for making silk.
french: Un mûrier aux fruits rouge violacé. Ses feuilles nourrissent les vers à soie, ce qui en fait une plante essentielle à la production de soie.
english: A mulberry tree with purplish-red fruit. Its leaves feed silkworms, making it important for silk production.

source: I feel great while I spend it on tatami mats!
french: Quel plaisir de passer du temps sur un tatami !
english: It feels wonderful to spend time on tatami!
